_comment: FIELD MARSHALS. The boss fight, built without a health bar -- because there is no health anywhere in this game and adding one here would break the single rule everything else rests on.
_howABossWorks: A marshal is padded head to foot and paint on the body does not count. Only the HOPPER counts, and a hopper is about eighteen centimetres across. So a boss is still one hit -- it is just a very small hit, at range, on someone who is better than you and who has an escort. That makes the boss fight a precision test, which is exactly what this game exists to train. A boss with three thousand health would have been a bullet sponge in an aim trainer.

common._hopperNote: Sits just above and behind the shoulder, which means the shot is available when they lean out and gone when they square up. Learning that timing IS the fight.

marshal.subtitle: White armband. Does not talk.
marshal._moveStyle: Holds long angles and rotates on a timer. She will not push you; she will make you come to her and she will be pre-aimed when you do.
marshal.intro: Somebody in a white armband walks out to the fifty and does not look at you.
marshal.defeat: She checks her hopper, nods once at the paint on it, and walks off the field.

quartermaster.subtitle: Runs the crate. Objects to you taking things out of it.
quartermaster._moveStyle: Walks at you behind a wall of paint. Bigger hopper, closer range, much less patient -- the opposite exam to the Marshal.
quartermaster.intro: A very large man puts down a crate, picks up a marker, and sighs.
quartermaster.defeat: "Fine. Take it. Take the whole crate."

twins.subtitle: Two of them. Both count.
twins._moveStyle: They set a crossfire on purpose and hold it. Both hoppers have to be marked and the second one relocates the moment the first goes out.
twins.intro: Two of them walk out to opposite corners without discussing it.
twins.defeat: The second one looks at the first one's jersey for a while.

aurumMarshal.subtitle: Gold marker. Wave forty.
aurumMarshal.intro: Forty waves in, someone walks out carrying the marker from behind the counter.
aurumMarshal.defeat: She hands it to you barrel-first, which is the polite way, and walks back toward the barn.

schedule._note: Which boss shows up where. The gauntlet's boss chapter is always the Marshal; horde cycles.
